b3b08e35832c.zh: 步幅、通道、填充與輸出尺寸 Stride, Channels, Padding, and Output Dimensions
b3b08e35832c.en: Stride, Channels, Padding, and Output Size

48548518f871.zh: 卷積運算的幾何輸出完全由四個超參數旋鈕決定：Stride（步幅）、Width（核寬）、Channels（通道深度） 與 Padding（填充邊界）。透過經典幾何公式 $\lfloor(d-f+2p)/s+1\rfloor$，精確預測每一層特徵圖的空間解析度，並釐清核深度與輸出特徵圖張數的本質差異。
48548518f871.en: The geometric output of a convolution is fully determined by four hyperparameter knobs: stride, width (kernel width), channels (channel depth) and padding (border padding). With the classic geometric formula $\lfloor(d-f+2p)/s+1\rfloor$ you can predict exactly the spatial resolution of every layer's feature map, and clarify the essential difference between kernel depth and the number of output feature maps.

beda3d012091.zh:
「不補邊輸出會縮一圈；padding 把那圈補回來！」 核中心對不到最外圈畫素，valid 必然縮邊；邊界尺寸公式精確掌管空間解析度。
Unpadded convolution shrinks the feature map; padding restores spatial dimensions.
beda3d012091.en: “Without padding the output shrinks by one ring; padding puts that ring back!” The kernel center cannot reach the outermost ring of pixels, so valid convolution always shrinks the border; the size formula governs the spatial resolution exactly.

458a63fbdba6.zh: 四大控制旋鈕：stride、width、channels、padding The Four Primary Control Knobs of Convolution
458a63fbdba6.en: The four control knobs: stride, width, channels, padding

10b77b2f965d.zh: 濾波器在空間網格上滑動時每次移動的格數。$s=1$ 為逐畫素連續平移；$s=2$ 每次跳躍 2 格，相當於在卷積階段直接進行下取樣，輸出尺寸大致折半。
10b77b2f965d.en: The number of cells the filter moves each time it slides over the spatial grid. $s=1$ shifts one pixel at a time; $s=2$ jumps 2 cells each time, which amounts to downsampling directly in the convolution stage and roughly halves the output size.

738fde905d21.zh: 濾波核的長寬尺寸 $f$（現代多為 $3\times 3$ 或 $5\times 5$）。小核專注微觀細節，大核一次涵蓋更寬廣的局部上下文。
738fde905d21.en: The height and width $f$ of the kernel (nowadays mostly $3\times 3$ or $5\times 5$). Small kernels focus on fine details; large kernels cover a wider local context at once.

51e7e8b00ef0.zh: 關鍵澄清：一顆濾波核的「深度」必須嚴格對齊輸入通道數 $C_{in}$！而「輸出特徵圖張數 $C_{out}$」則是由有幾顆獨立的濾波核所決定。兩者絕對不能混淆！
51e7e8b00ef0.en: Key clarification: the “depth” of one kernel must match the number of input channels $C_{in}$ exactly! The “number of output feature maps $C_{out}$”, on the other hand, is determined by how many independent kernels there are. Never mix the two up!

83e069883157.zh: 在輸入影像外圍擴充邊界畫素圈數 $p$。完全不補邊稱為 valid padding（$p=0$）；維持輸入與輸出長寬相同的設定稱為 same padding。
83e069883157.en: Extend the input image with $p$ rings of border pixels around it. No padding at all is called valid padding ($p=0$); the setting that keeps the output height and width equal to the input's is called same padding.

77a59873e90d.zh: 03 / 數學定理 · Output Dimension Formula

b2c0ab4711eb.zh: 式 (6)：輸出特徵圖空間尺寸精確定理 Equation (6): Spatial Output Dimension Formulation
b2c0ab4711eb.en: Equation (6): the exact formula for the spatial size of the output feature map

d5c2cc854193.zh: 設輸入長寬為 $d$、卷積核寬為 $f$、單側填充為 $p$、步幅為 $s$。輸出特徵圖的空間尺寸嚴格由下式決定：
d5c2cc854193.en: Let the input height/width be $d$, the kernel width $f$, the padding on each side $p$, and the stride $s$. The spatial size of the output feature map is given exactly by:

f92dddde8e79.zh: 其中 $\lfloor\cdot\rfloor$ 代表無條件向下取整（Floor 運算）。
f92dddde8e79.en: where $\lfloor\cdot\rfloor$ means rounding down (the floor operation).

fcb77ba38e19.zh: 有效覆蓋跨度：$d + 2p - f$ 為濾波核可在輸入邊界內滑動的最大淨位移。
fcb77ba38e19.en: Effective coverage span: $d + 2p - f$ is the largest net displacement over which the kernel can slide within the input border.

8133be3f0b28.zh: 段數計算：除以步幅 $s$ 後取整，再加上初始出發的第 1 格，即得輸出邊長。
8133be3f0b28.en: Counting the steps: divide by the stride $s$ and round down, then add the first starting position to get the output side length.

22640e59de91.zh:
算例 1 (Valid)：$d=5, f=3, p=0, s=1 \implies \lfloor(5-3+0)/1 + 1\rfloor = 3$（$5\times 5 \to 3\times 3$，外圈被削掉一圈）。
算例 2 (Same)：$d=5, f=3, p=1, s=1 \implies \lfloor(5-3+2)/1 + 1\rfloor = 5$（$5\times 5 \to 5\times 5$，尺寸完美保全）。
22640e59de91.en:
Example 1 (Valid): $d=5, f=3, p=0, s=1 \implies \lfloor(5-3+0)/1 + 1\rfloor = 3$ ($5\times 5 \to 3\times 3$, one outer ring is shaved off).
Example 2 (Same): $d=5, f=3, p=1, s=1 \implies \lfloor(5-3+2)/1 + 1\rfloor = 5$ ($5\times 5 \to 5\times 5$, the size is perfectly preserved).

a6b962ed81a6.en: Textbook Fig. 5 and Fig. 6: from single-channel planes to 3D tensors

36b87cafe806.zh: 立體張量卷積的正確心智模型
36b87cafe806.en: The right mental model for convolution on 3D tensors

2363c7df2998.zh: 單通道卷積（Fig. 5）：$1 \text{ 個平面輸入} \times 1 \text{ 個 2D 核} \implies 1 \text{ 張輸出特徵圖}$。
2363c7df2998.en: Single-channel convolution (Fig. 5): $1 \text{ planar input} \times 1 \text{ 2D kernel} \implies 1 \text{ output feature map}$.

d35fb91bba39.zh: 多通道卷積（Fig. 6）：輸入有 3 個色彩通道（RGB）。此時每一顆濾波核本身就是一個 3D 張量（尺寸為 $f \times f \times 3$）！ 它在 3 個通道上分別做 2D 乘加，並在通道維度求和，輸出依然是單張 2D 特徵圖。
d35fb91bba39.en: Multichannel convolution (Fig. 6): the input has 3 color channels (RGB). Now each kernel is itself a 3D tensor (of size $f \times f \times 3$)! It does a 2D multiply-add on each of the 3 channels and sums over the channel dimension, and the output is still a single 2D feature map.

769462eda2c7.zh: 產生多張特徵圖：如果你希望下一層擁有 16 個特徵通道，你必須準備 16 顆互不相干的 3D 濾波核！ 總參數量即為：$f \times f \times C_{in} \times C_{out}$（加上 $C_{out}$ 個偏置項）。
769462eda2c7.en: Producing multiple feature maps: if you want the next layer to have 16 feature channels, you must prepare 16 mutually independent 3D kernels! The total number of parameters is then $f \times f \times C_{in} \times C_{out}$ (plus $C_{out}$ biases).

672203adfc68.en: Mental-math tip: the effective span (d − f + 2p) is the filter's sliding room; divide by stride s to get the steps!

ac9e5f392e23.zh: 若出現非整數，Floor 運算會截斷無法完整對齊的右側邊界；在 PyTorch 中預設即遵循向下取整機制。

685c43195cca.en: Diagram: how the spatial size evolves under valid padding vs same padding

78ec45b9ebd1.zh: 英文名詞「Valid」常被誤解為「合法的／正確的」。實際上，在訊號處理歷史中，Valid 只是指「完全不擴充邊界、只在純淨原訊號內部運算」。
78ec45b9ebd1.en: The English word “valid” is often misread as “legal / correct”. In fact, in the history of signal processing, valid just means “do not extend the border at all; compute only inside the pure original signal”.

40d3d6029734.zh: 在現代數十層乃至上百層的深層神經網路中，若每一層都用 Valid，特徵圖長寬會迅速縮減為 0。因此現代架構（如 ResNet）幾乎全數採用 $3\times 3$ 搭配 $p=1$ 的 Same Padding 保持空間尺寸！
40d3d6029734.en: In modern deep networks with dozens or even hundreds of layers, if every layer used valid padding, the feature-map height and width would quickly shrink to 0. That is why modern architectures (such as ResNet) almost all use $3\times 3$ with $p=1$, i.e. same padding, to preserve the spatial size!
